title: Easy Spanish Chicken & Chorizo Stew
ingredients: 2 × 400g cans butter beans, drained and rinsed
large handful of parsley, finely chopped
steps: In a large casserole dish with lid, fry chorizo for 2 minutes until sizzling.
Add chicken; stir-fry 5 minutes until no pink showing.
Add onions, garlic, celery, carrots and peppers; lid on; cook gently on low for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in stock; add butter beans, smoked paprika, thyme and tomato purée. Stir; simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.
Add lemon juice and most of parsley; stir; scatter remaining parsley over top.
notes: Replace chicken with pork or sausage if preferred. Add a handful of olives for extra Spanish flavour. Freezer-friendly.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
